sentences.text:
This is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS) for grant of anticipatory bail apprehending his arrest in relation to Crime No.327/2025 registered at Police Station - Junnardeo, District Chhindwara (M.P.)
for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.
2.

As per the prosecution story, the complainants Manoj Yadav and Vinod Yadav, are the sons of Late Smt. Lalta Bai Yaduvanshi, who had purchased land bearing Survey No. 483/9, area 0.300 hectare, through a registered sale deed dated 06.01.2003.
After her death in 2014, the land remained recorded in her name, and mutation was not carried out in favour of her legal heirs.

During the year 2024, the accused persons Satpal Pal, Indra Singh Chauhan, Malti Jaiswal,
Chandrapal Pawar, Obesh Khan, and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:56062 2 MCRC-45508-2025 Ajesh Suryavanshi allegedly entered into a criminal conspiracy to fraudulently obtain ownership of the said land.

In furtherance of the conspiracy, they are said to have prepared a forged Aadhaar card in the name of Lalita Bai, using the photograph of accused Malti Jaiswal and thereby impersonated the deceased woman to get the land re-registered in the name of co-accused Indra Singh Chauhan before the Sub- Registrar, Junardeo.
On verification, it was found that the forged Aadhaar card bare the same photograph as Malti Jaiswal's genuine card, confirming impersonation and forgery.
Therefore, the offence has been registered against the applicant and co-accused persons under aforesaid offences.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant is not the beneficiary.
It is submitted that the applicant is the service provider for slot booking of registration of sale deed.

The applicant has only uploaded Chandrapal Pawar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17451035/
1 the documents in the system, which have been provided by the concerned person.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that it is the duty of Sub Registrar to verify those documents.
There is no role of the applicant in this transaction.
There is no need of custodial interrogation of the applicant.
There is no criminal antecedents of the applicant.
The conclusion of trial will take considerable time.

Therefore,
it has been prayed that the applicant may be granted benefit of anticipatory bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant and has submitted that the applicant has made conspiracy alongwith co-accused for execution of sale deed of the land NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:56062 3 MCRC-45508-2025 in question.

It is further submitted that in the statements of the witnesses it has come that the applicant has already knew the fact that real owner of the said land is Lalita Bai and she has expired and Malti Jaiswal has impersonated herself to be Lalita Bai at the time of execution of sale deed, he uploaded the documents in the system.
He actively participation in the commission of the offence.
The custodial interrogation of the applicant is also required in this case.

Therefore,
the applicant does not deserve grant of anticipatory bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.
Looking to aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, present MCRC stands dismissed.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE mohsin Chandrapal Pawar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17451035/
